name: Fifth Third Bancorp
tagline: Diversified financial services company providing commercial banking, consumer banking, and wealth management solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Composante majeure du revenu total (66% en 2025), reflétant la dépendance de Fifth Third au revenu d'intérêts nets sur les prêts et les dépôts comme principal moteur de performance financière

kpis.signal: NIM FTE en hausse de 2.90% (2024) à 3.11% (2025), portée par la baisse du coût des dépôts (-55bps) et le repricing des actifs à taux fixe.
kpis.notes: Q4 non disponible: FITB ne publie le NIM (FTE, non-GAAP) que sur base FY dans le 10-K, sans tableau trimestriel Q4 distinct. 9 trous (2016-2024) confirmes reels, non comblables sans inventer de valeur.

kpis.signal: Encours moyen des prêts commerciaux en hausse de 72.2Md$ à 74.9Md$ (+2.7Md$). Croissance freinée par la baisse des rendements sur prêts à court terme.
Encours moyen consommateurs +3.0Md$ à 48.5Md$, porté par prêts indirects sécurisés (+11.3%), hypothèques résidentielles et prêts solaires.
Revenus WAM à 704M$ (+57M$ vs 2024), portés par la gestion privée et le courtage. AUM gérés: 80Md$ (vs 69Md$ en 2024, +15.9%). Actifs sous soin: 690Md$.
kpis.notes: Q4-2016 comble: 100 M$ = FY2016 (404) - Q1(102, source 10-Q 2016-05-06) - Q2(101) - Q3(101). Q1-2017 trou etait en fait deja present, pas de trou reel restant.

kpis.signal: AUM gérés 80Md$ au 31/12/2025 vs 69Md$ en 2024. Actifs sous soin total: 690Md$ (vs 634Md$ en 2024, +8.8%).
Originations hypothécaires résidentielles à 7.5Md$ en 2025 vs 6.5Md$ en 2024, portées par la baisse des taux et la hausse du volume dans le canal correspondent.
kpis.notes: trou reel, non comblable: volume Residential Mortgage Loan Originations non divulgue par trimestre dans les 10-Q correspondants (2018-2020: seul Q1+FY publie; 2024-2025: seul Q1+Q3 publie). Verifie dans FITB_2017-08-08, FITB_2024-08-06 (pas de chiffre trimestriel).

kpis.signal: Dépôts à vue (demand) 42.6Md$ sur total dépôts 171.8Md$ = 24.8%. Dépôts core +4.9Md$ (+3%) à 169.8Md$, représentant 77% des actifs moyens.
Revenus nets mortgage banking à 227M$ vs 211M$ en 2024 (+16M$). Hausse des frais d'origination et gains sur cessions, partiellement compensée par la variation des MSR.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is identified as a material risk factor in the 10-K, with specific mention of loan concentration among borrowers in similar industries and geographies. The Bancorp's credit losses are sensitive to economic conditions and borrower performance.
risks.summary: Credit risk is a major risk for Fifth Third, arising from potential deterioration in borrower credit quality, particularly from concentrated lending to specific industries and geographic markets.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Liquidity risk is identified as an important risk factor related to Fifth Third's dependence on deposit funding and exposure to financial market volatility. The Bancorp manages liquidity through various funding strategies.
risks.summary: Liquidity risk is important for Fifth Third, stemming from dependence on deposit funding and potential market disruptions affecting the Bancorp's access to funding.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk is identified as an important risk factor related to Fifth Third's reliance on technology systems and the potential for security breaches and operational disruptions.
risks.summary: Operational risk is important for Fifth Third, arising from the Bancorp's dependence on technology systems, processes, and people to deliver financial services.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risk is identified as a major risk factor affecting financial institutions, with potential for data breaches, system compromises, and operational disruptions affecting customer trust and regulatory compliance.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risk is a major risk for Fifth Third, reflecting the frequency of cyber attacks on financial institutions and potential impacts on operations and customer confidence.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risk is identified as an important risk factor related to potential changes in banking regulations and the need for Fifth Third to maintain compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.
risks.summary: Regulatory risk is important for Fifth Third, arising from potential regulatory changes affecting banking operations, capital requirements, and compliance obligations.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputational risk is identified as an important risk factor related to the need to maintain customer trust, particularly in light of operational incidents or regulatory actions.
risks.summary: Reputational risk is important for Fifth Third, arising from the need to maintain customer confidence and trust in the Bancorp's services and operations.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Market risk is identified as an important risk factor related to volatility in financial markets and exposure to interest rate changes affecting the Bancorp's net interest margin and securities portfolio.
risks.summary: Market risk is important for Fifth Third, stemming from volatility in financial markets and exposure to interest rate fluctuations affecting net interest income and investments.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Counterparty risk is identified as an important risk factor related to potential default of financial counterparties and the need to maintain strong counterparty relationships.
risks.summary: Counterparty risk is important for Fifth Third, arising from potential counterparty defaults and the need to maintain diversified and resilient counterparty relationships.

company_description: Fifth Third Bancorp operates as the bank holding company for Fifth Third Bank, National Association that provides a range of financial products and services in the United States. It operates through three segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer and Small Business Banking, and Wealth and Asset Management. The Commercial Banking segment offers credit intermediation, cash management, and financial services; lending and depository products; and cash management, foreign exchange and international trade finance, derivatives and capital markets services, asset-based lending, real estate finance, public finance, commercial leasing, and syndicated finance for business, government, and professional customers. Its Consumer and Small Banking segment engages in the provision of a range of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses; residential mortgage activities, including the origination, retention and servicing of residential mortgage loans, sales and securitizations of loans, and associated hedging activities; home equity loans and lines of credit, credit cards, automobile and other indirect lending, and other consumer lending services; and home improvement and solar energ

kpis_explanation_fr.Net Interest Income: Revenu généré par les intérêts sur prêts et dépôts, exprimé en pourcentage du revenu total.
kpis_explanation_fr.Noninterest Income: Revenu issu d'activités hors intérêts incluant gestion de patrimoine, paiements et marchés de capitaux, exprimé en pourcentage du revenu total.

risks_rationale_fr.0: Risque de crédit identifié comme matériel dans le 10-K avec concentration de prêts par secteurs et géographies. Pertes sensibles aux conditions économiques et à la performance emprunteurs.
risks_rationale_fr.1: Risque de liquidité important lié à la dépendance au financement par dépôts et à la volatilité des marchés. Géré via stratégies de financement diverses.
risks_rationale_fr.2: Risque opérationnel important lié à la dépendance aux systèmes technologiques et au potentiel de brèches de sécurité et disruptions.
risks_rationale_fr.3: Cyber identifié comme risque majeur pour les institutions financières : brèches de données, compromissions systèmes, disruptions affectant confiance clients et conformité.
risks_rationale_fr.4: Risque réglementaire important lié aux évolutions des régulations bancaires et au besoin de Fifth Third de maintenir la conformité aux exigences en évolution.
risks_rationale_fr.5: Risque réputationnel important lié au besoin de maintenir la confiance clients, particulièrement en cas d'incidents opérationnels ou d'actions réglementaires.
risks_rationale_fr.6: Risque de marché important lié à la volatilité des marchés et à l'exposition aux variations de taux affectant marge nette d'intérêt et portefeuille titres.
risks_rationale_fr.7: Risque de contrepartie important lié aux défauts potentiels de contreparties financières et au besoin de maintenir des relations solides.
